tok 1.0 "Claims notification"

pool org "Organization"
  lane clerk "Claims handler"
    start received "Claim received"
    task checkins "Check whether the claimant is insured"
    xor insured "Claimant insured?"
    task reject "Inform the claimant that the claim is rejected"
    end rejected "Claim rejected"
    task evaluate "Evaluate the severity of the claim"
    task sendforms "Send relevant forms to the claimant"
    task checkforms "Check the forms for completeness"
    xor complete "Forms complete?"
    task register "Register the claim in the Claims Management system"
    end done "Claim registered"
    task update "Inform the claimant to update the forms"
    task receive "Receive the updated forms"

flow received -> checkins -> insured
flow insured -> reject "no"
flow insured -> evaluate "yes"
flow reject -> rejected
flow evaluate -> sendforms -> checkforms -> complete
flow complete -> register "yes"
flow complete -> update "no"
flow register -> done
flow update -> receive -> checkforms
